LISTEN: Historic Salubria set for major preservation, access improvements

by

Ted Schubel
Audio Player

Instaread

The three-year project will address drainage and moisture issues, protect historic materials, improve visitor safety, and create an ADA-accessible entrance.

Executive Director Jennifer Hurst-Wender says the work is also expected to allow Salubria’s second floor, currently closed for safety reasons, to reopen.

The 1757 home will be featured during the Salubria Oktoberfest and History Faire on October 17.  germanna.org
